questions.stem:
—______ you ______ your homework yet? 
—Yes, I finished it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是B。yet是现在完成时的典型标志词，常用于疑问句和否定句中，表示"已经"。虽然答句用了一般过去时（finished）说明过去某个具体时间完成的动作，但问句强调的是"到目前为止是否完成"，所以用现在完成时Have you finished。A选项Did finish是一般过去时，不能与yet连用；C是现在进行时；D是一般现在时，均不符合语境。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ cover is red belongs to the library.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是C。这是定语从句，先行词是the book，而cover（封面）与book之间存在所属关系（书的主封面），所以要用关系代词whose，表示"...的"。A选项who只能指人；B选项which和D选项that在定语从句中作主语或宾语，但不能表示所属关系。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old buildings ______ by the government next year to make room for new schools.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是B。主语These old buildings（旧建筑）与动词短语pull down（拆除）之间是被动关系，建筑是被拆除的。时间状语next year表示将来，所以要用一般将来时的被动语态will be pulled down。A是主动语态；C是现在进行时的主动语态；D是一般过去时主动语态，均不符合被动关系和时态要求。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Is that Mr. Wang knocking at the door? 
—It ______ be him. He has gone to Shanghai on business.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是C。根据后句"He has gone to Shanghai"（他去上海出差了）可知，敲门的不可能是王先生，这是有依据的否定推测，要用can't be（不可能是）。must be表示肯定推测；might be表示不确定的推测；mustn't表示"禁止"，不用于推测。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: After running for 30 minutes in the hot sun, the boy felt dizzy and almost fell down. The underlined word "dizzy" means ______.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是B。根据上下文语境：在烈日下跑步30分钟后，男孩几乎要摔倒（almost fell down），可以推断dizzy的意思是"头晕的、眩晕的"。这是典型的通过上下文情境猜测词义的题目，关键是要找到"hot sun"、"running"、"fell down"这些线索词。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We need to ______ a good idea to solve this difficult problem.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是A。come up with意为"想出、提出（主意、计划等）"，常与idea、plan、solution等词搭配。B选项look up to意为"尊敬、敬仰"；C选项put up with意为"忍受、容忍"；D选项get up to意为"忙于（某事）；达到"。根据句意"想出一个好主意"，只有A符合。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is ______ to talk loudly in the library because it disturbs other readers. (polite)
questions.explanation: 正确答案是B。系动词is后面需要形容词作表语，排除C和D（副词）。根据句意"在图书馆大声说话会打扰他人"，可知这是"不礼貌的"行为，所以要加否定前缀im-，构成impolite。A选项polite（礼貌的）与句意相反。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 正确答案是A。根据上下文，学校发起环保项目，每个班被要求在阳台上"建造"小花园，build（建造）符合语境。destroy（破坏）与文意相反；find（找到）和borrow（借）与garden搭配不当。解题关键：理解project和garden之间的逻辑关系。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started an interesting project called "Green Classroom". The goal was to help students understand the importance of protecting the environment.

Every class was asked to (8)______ a small garden on the balcony. At first, many students thought it would be easy. (9)______, they soon realized it was harder than expected. We had to learn how to plant seeds, how much water the plants needed, and when to move them into the sun.

My class decided to grow tomatoes. We worked in groups and (10)______ turns to take care of them. Some students brought soil from home, while others bought young plants from the market. It was amazing to see how fast they grew day by day.

However, we also faced some challenges. One week, the weather was too hot and some leaves turned yellow. We felt worried but didn't give up. (11)______ the Internet for help, we learned to water them more frequently and put up a simple umbrella to provide shade.

After two months, our tomatoes finally turned red. When we shared the fresh vegetables with teachers and classmates, everyone felt proud. This experience taught us that (12)______ nature requires patience and knowledge. It also showed us how small actions can make a big difference to our environment.

questions.explanation: 正确答案是B。前句说"起初许多学生认为这很容易"，后句说"他们很快意识到比预期难"，前后是转折关系，所以用However（然而）。Therefore（因此）表因果；Besides（此外）表递进；Otherwise（否则）表条件，均不符合逻辑关系。

questions.stem: According to the study mentioned in the passage, students who sleep ______ usually get better test scores.
options: A. less than 6 hours a night
D. more than 10 hours a night
questions.explanation: 正确答案是C。细节理解题。根据文章第二段第二句"Their test scores were actually lower than those who slept 8 hours"（睡眠不足6小时的学生成绩实际上低于睡8小时的学生），可推断出睡8小时的学生成绩更好。解题技巧：细节题要回到原文找关键词test scores和hours，进行精确定位和比对。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Many students sacrifice sleep to study for exams, believing that more study time leads to better grades. However, recent scientific research suggests this might not be the best strategy.

Scientists at a university in the UK studied over 1,000 students. They found that students who slept less than 6 hours a night usually had trouble concentrating in class. Their test scores were actually lower than those who slept 8 hours. "Sleep is like a reset button for your brain," explains Dr. Smith, the lead researcher. "During deep sleep, your brain organizes information from the day and moves it into long-term memory."

The study also discovered that the quality of sleep matters. Even if students spent 8 hours in bed, poor sleep quality (caused by phone use before bed or too much caffeine) could still affect their learning ability. The blue light from phone screens tricks the brain into thinking it is still daytime, making it harder to fall asleep.

So what is the solution? Experts recommend creating a bedtime routine. This means going to bed at the same time every night and keeping phones out of the bedroom. They also suggest taking short naps (15-20 minutes) after lunch if you feel tired, but not longer, as this can make you feel groggy (昏昏沉沉的).

Remember, good sleep isn't laziness—it's an important part of successful learning.

questions.stem: The underlined word "concentrating" in Paragraph 2 probably means ______.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是A。词义猜测题。根据上下文，文章讨论的是睡眠与学习的关系，睡眠不足会导致在课堂上难以concentrating，进而影响成绩。结合常识，睡眠不足会导致"注意力不集中"，且con-是"共同/一起"，-centr-是"中心"，合起来就是"把思想集中在中心/一点上"，即集中注意力。解题技巧：通过构词法（con-共同，centr-中心，-ing形容词后缀）和上下文语境（sleep less...trouble...test scores lower）双重线索确定词义。

B. Using phones before bed has no effect on sleep.

questions.explanation: 正确答案是C。推理判断题。根据第二段最后一句"During deep sleep, your brain organizes information...into long-term memory"（深度睡眠时，大脑将信息整理并移入长期记忆），可推断出良好的睡眠有助于提高记忆力。A选项错误，因为文章说小睡不超过20分钟，太长会使人昏昏沉沉；B选项与第三段内容相反；D选项与第一段内容相反。解题技巧：推理题要基于原文信息合理推断，不能过度推断，也不能选择与原文矛盾的选项。

questions.stem: What is the best title for this passage?
options: A. The History of Sleep Research
B. How to Use Your Phone Less
C. Why Sleep Matters for Students
questions.explanation: 正确答案是C。主旨大意题。文章通篇讨论睡眠对学生学习的重要性：第一段指出少睡觉多学习并非好策略，第二段说明睡眠不足影响注意力和成绩，第三段讲睡眠质量的重要性，第四段给出建议，最后总结睡眠是成功学习的重要部分。A选项（睡眠研究历史）只在第二段提到研究，非主旨；B选项（如何少用手机）只在第三段提及；D选项（不同类型的梦）文中未提及。解题技巧：选择能覆盖全文主要内容的标题，避免以偏概全或超出范围。

Many students find it difficult to balance their schoolwork with their hobbies. They often feel stressed when they can't do both well. (17)______ Here are some tips to help you manage your time better.

(18)______ First, write down all your assignments and their deadlines. This helps you see clearly what needs to be done first.

Next, create a weekly schedule. (19)______ For example, you can study for 45 minutes and then play the guitar for 15 minutes. This way, you won't feel bored or tired.

Finally, try to cut down on time-wasting activities like spending too much time on social media. (20)______ What matters is that you are making progress step by step.

questions.explanation: 正确答案是C。后句出现"First, write down..."（首先，写下...），说明此处需要总起句引出第一个建议。C选项"第一步是制作待办清单"中的first step与后面的First对应，且make a to-do list与write down assignments语义一致。E已经用过；A是总结句；B和D与first无关。
